name: Congenital Pulmonary Veins Atresia or Stenosis

criteria.description: Demonstration of pulmonary vein atresia or stenosis on echocardiography, CT angiography, or cardiac MRI
Presence of respiratory distress or recurrent pulmonary infections in infancy or early childhood
Evidence of pulmonary venous obstruction or pulmonary hypertension on cardiac catheterization or echocardiography
Exclusion of acquired causes of pulmonary vein stenosis or atresia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of imaging-confirmed pulmonary vein atresia or stenosis plus clinical presentation consistent with pulmonary venous obstruction
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires multimodal imaging and exclusion of secondary causes.

pathognomonic.notes: Direct consequence of atresia or stenosis
searchTerms: obstruction in veins of the lungs

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe respiratory distress in neonates or infants

laboratory: Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) indicating cardiac strain
Hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
imaging: Echocardiography showing absent or narrowed pulmonary veins
CT angiography or cardiac MRI confirming pulmonary vein atresia or stenosis
Cardiac catheterization demonstrating pulmonary venous obstruction and pulmonary hypertension
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; may be sporadic or associated with congenital heart defects
other: Histopathology may show intimal proliferation and fibrosis in stenotic veins

distinguishingFeatures: Abnormal pulmonary venous drainage to systemic veins
Usually presents with cyanosis and right heart volume overload
Pulmonary vein stenosis due to external compression or post-surgical scarring
History of cardiac surgery or mediastinal mass

redFlags: Severe hypoxemia refractory to oxygen therapy
Signs of right heart failure in infancy
references: Gaynor JW et al. Pulmonary vein stenosis: diagnosis and management. Circulation. 2015.
Latus H et al. Congenital pulmonary vein atresia: clinical presentation and outcome. Pediatr Cardiol. 2018.
Orphanet: Congenital pulmonary veins atresia or stenosis. ORPHA:3188.
